GRIMPULSE.SlainHint: Announce the selected tokens as dead
GRIMPULSE.HandleHint: Drag to move. Double-click to reset the position.

Death.Title: Death saving throw
Death.Wait: Waiting for the player to roll

Warn.SelectToken: Grim Pulse: select a token first.
Warn.DeathSave: Grim Pulse: the death saving throw could not be rolled. Roll it from the character sheet.

theme.Name: Colour theme
theme.Hint: Set by the GM for the whole table. Same four themes as Grim Almanac.

scale.Name: Size
scale.Hint: Scale of the turn strip on your own screen.

maxTurns.Name: Turns shown
maxTurns.Hint: How many upcoming turns the strip shows at once.

playerNumbers.Name: Exact HP and AC shown to players
playerNumbers.Hint: Everyone else is shown as a heartbeat line and blood stains only. The GM always sees the numbers.

imageSource.Name: Picture used
imageSource.Hint: Which image fills the turn frame.

skipDead.Name: End turn skips the dead
skipDead.Hint: The End turn button passes over any non-player combatant at 0 HP. Foundry's own tracker buttons are not affected.

deathSavePrompt.Name: Death save die
deathSavePrompt.Hint: When a player character starts their turn at 0 HP, show a die on everyone's screen. Only the character's owner or the GM can click it.

roundBanner.Name: Round banner
roundBanner.Hint: Dim the screen and sweep the round number across it when a new round begins.

bannerRoundOne.Name: Round banner on round 1
bannerRoundOne.Hint: Leave this off if another module, such as Encounter FX, already announces the start of combat.

encounterEnd.Name: Encounter End text
encounterEnd.Hint: Slowly bring up "Encounter End" when the combat is ended.

hideCoreTracker.Name: Hide Foundry's Combat Tracker from players
hideCoreTracker.Hint: Removes the Combat tab from the sidebar for players. The GM always keeps it.
